description: HEAVY-DUTY all-PETG structural shelf - Roman arch design
design_philosophy: Overbuilt for PETG creep. Thick sections, many ribs, mechanical fasteners.

load_rating.basis: Conservative estimate for 40mm deep PETG box beam over 17in max span with 5mm walls and gyroid infill. Accounts for PETG creep with 2x safety factor on deflection.
load_rating.load_distribution: Evenly distributed across shelf. No concentrated point loads at front edge.
load_rating.increase_to_100lb_requires: Add 4th bracket at wall end (requires blocking) OR reduce max span to 12in OR increase deck depth to 50mm

arch_bracket.print_orientation: Arch opening facing UP - layers perpendicular to load
arch_bracket.supports: YES - for arch interior and counterbores
arch_bracket.description: Heavy-duty Roman arch wall bracket, 4 screws into stud

deck_segment.print_orientation: Top face DOWN for smooth surface

end_bracket.description: End support bracket, bolts to deck underside

wall_screws.spec: #10 x 3 in wood screws (or GRK RSS 1/4 x 3 in)
wall_screws.note: 4 per bracket into stud. Longer screws for better engagement.

wall_washers.note: Large washers distribute load on PETG

deck_bolts.note: 6 per deck-bracket joint (3 brackets × 2 ends × 8 decks, minus overlaps)

print_settings.note: Slower speed and hotter temps for better layer adhesion = stronger parts
